messages:
emily: Heads-up: submitting a docs PR that updates the /v1/generate examples. I accidentally left an array example in the request body which is wrong for current API contract. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2401

riley: Which file? need to patch snippets and openapi examples if it's used by the site.

emily: docs/generate.md and openapi/examples/generate.json. Example currently shows:
```json
[ { "prompt": "Summarize this article" } ]
```
should be:
```json
{ "input": "Summarize this article" }
```
Also the response example uses `text` as a string not an array of choice objects: shows `{ "id": "g_1", "text": "ok" }` but schema expects `choices: [{ "text": "ok" }]`.

marta: cc @samir since SDKs pull examples. If docs stay as array we'll break generated TS/Go snippets. Add a migration note for anyone following older docs.

samir: I'll lock the snippet generation on my side until docs PR is merged. Please keep parameter names stable: we standardized on `max_new_tokens` and `temperature` field names. No camelCase renames.

emily: Will not change param names. Plan: update request/response snippets, openapi example, and add a short "breaking change" paragraph under the top of generate.md explaining the array->object shift. Will run `yarn docs:build` locally.

riley: Also check examples/snippets/js/generate.ts and snippets/python/generate_example.py — both are referenced by the docs site.

docsbot: lint:examples failed on docs/generate.md: line 78 - response does not match schema. CI: https://ci.redwood/linters/9991

emily: Pushed docs-only fix at 1724601320 in PR 2402. Replaced array with object in all examples, fixed response to include `choices: [{ "text": "..." }]`.

samir: Will update the snippet extraction script to pick the corrected example after merge. I'll open an SDK PR referencing docs commit.

marta: Quick checklist for PR description: list changed files, include migration note header "Note on request body shape", confirm `max_new_tokens` kept, smoke test rendered page. I'll review after checks pass. Targeting merge before EOD.

emily: Also added a one-line migration snippet for older users: "Older examples used an array body; switch to {\"input\":...} for current API."

riley: Minor: keep the JS example variable named `promptText` while replacing the example payload field to `input` so our code examples read naturally.

samir: Confirmed. I won't touch streaming examples; this is only for non-streaming generate.

emily: Merged at 1724601450. Closing follow-up issue #590. Thanks all for quick reviews.
